title: Is it really vegetarian?
persona: Maya, late twenties, a strict vegetarian who has been caught out before. Friendly but careful, asks follow-up questions.
goal: Order one vegetarian pizza and a drink for delivery. Make sure nothing on it comes from an animal that was killed.

title: What's the dessert of the day?
persona: Sam, a regular with a sweet tooth, cheerful and a bit impatient. Calls mostly for the dessert.
goal: Find out what the dessert of the day is, then order a pizza and two desserts.

title: Dinner for four on a budget
persona: Leo, a tired parent ordering for two adults and two kids, one of whom hates mushrooms. Polite, counting every euro.
goal: Order dinner for four for under 50 euros, nothing with mushrooms for the kids, and hear the exact total.
